history.text: Bantu, Arab and Malagasy settlement shaped the islands' mixed culture.
Rival sultanates ruled the individual islands.
France declared a protectorate over the archipelago.
Independence was declared on 6 July; Mayotte voted to remain French.
Repeated coups gave the islands one of the world's highest coup counts.
